messages.content: What do you think about abortion?

It's one of the most deeply contested ethical and political questions, with thoughtful people on all sides holding firm views grounded in different values — bodily autonomy, beliefs about when personhood begins, religious convictions. I try not to push a personal position on questions like this, but I'm happy to explain the arguments each side makes.
